property_summary: For any target and amount, when the owner calls sendMoney to a target whose fallback reverts, the reference contract always reverts (so the call to sendMoney does not succeed), but the mutant that ignores the low-level call success will allow sendMoney to return successfully for some inputs (owner call with value), breaking that rule.
change_summary: Change the low-level call to ignore the returned success flag (remove the revert on failure), so failed sends do not revert the transaction.
